description: Get a single salary submission by its UUID: company, title, level, location, years of experience, offer date, base salary and total compensation. Every amount is in USD; originalCurrency is only the currency the salary was submitted in. Use the uuid from a search-raw-data-points row. Free limit: Base salary and total compensation only, in USD. REQUIRED arguments: uuid.

uuid.description: The unique uuid of the salary

name: get-salary-submission-by-id
